input.title: A Light in the Attic
input.description: It's hard to imagine a world without A Light in the Attic. This now-classic collection of poetry and drawings from Shel Silverstein celebrates the vibrant and imaginative mind of the beloved poet and artist.

input.title: The Very Hungry Caterpillar
input.description: A picture book for very young children about a caterpillar who eats his way through a varied and very large quantity of food before pupating and emerging as a butterfly.

input.title: Pride and Prejudice
input.description: A classic novel of manners following Elizabeth Bennet as she deals with issues of marriage, morality, and misconceptions in the landed gentry society of early 19th-century England.

input.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
input.description: A survey of the history of humankind from the evolution of archaic human species to the political and technological revolutions of the twenty-first century, examining how biology and history have defined us.

input.title: Notes
input.description: A collection of things the author thought about at various points.

input.title: The Hobbit
input.description: Bilbo Baggins is a hobbit who enjoys a comfortable, unambitious life, rarely traveling any farther than his pantry or cellar. But his contentment is disturbed when the wizard Gandalf and a company of dwarves arrive on his doorstep.
